_note: Shared standards (Phase 8 Step 3, docs/CONTENT_PIPELINE.md): what a car is built to, so parts made to a standard fit every car built to it without listing cars part by part. A car lists its standards (car.json standards); garage/standards.js turns them into the tags parts' fits, requires and conflicts already use (garage/validate.js) — engine mounts and bay sizes, wheel bolt patterns and rim sizes, seat and steering wheel mounts, bumper, spoiler and exhaust mounting. All fictional: no maker's standard is copied.

engineMounts._note: Engine mount families: how the engine sits and bolts in. An engine is built for one family (data/engines: mounts).

long.label: Longitudinal, front
long.about: In line with the car, in the front: rear- and all-wheel drive

trans.label: Transverse, front
trans.about: Across the car, in the front: front-wheel drive

bays._note: Engine bay size classes, smallest first: a bay takes an engine its size or smaller. The size of an engine: its length, width and height at most these (metres).

boltPatterns._note: Wheel bolt patterns: studs × pitch circle (mm). A rim is drilled for one.

rimSizes._note: Rim diameters (inches) a car's standards may list: its wheels' range

std.label: Clip and bolt
std.about: Clips along the top, two bolts each side

tube.label: Tube frame
tube.about: Off-road: bolted to the chassis rails

boot.label: Boot lid
boot.about: Two or four bolts through the boot lid

roof.label: Roof edge
roof.about: A hatch's or estate's roof spoiler

std.label: Under the floor, out the back

side.label: Out the side, ahead of the rear wheel
